snippet.title: The Mysterious Thief Forget Me Not Trailer
snippet.description:
Dazzling phantom thief heists, romantic meetings in the dead of night, and making a name for yourself; The Mysterious Thief, Forget Me Not is a mostly linear, slice of life girl's love visual novel that features multiple POVs throughout.

You can play the free demo and buy the full game over at:

Itchio: https://solarprotagonist.itch.io/forget-me-not
Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3333600/The_Mysterious_Thief_Forget_Me_Not/

Where to find me:
🎮 Itch.io: https://solarprotagonist.itch.io/
📺 Twitch: https://www.twitch.tv/solarprotag
